description: Replace the single deployment-state badge with truthful runtime and readiness signals so Homebase can distinguish installed, service-running, HTTP-healthy, needs-onboarding, and unhealthy app states.

timing.gatingCondition: Requires agreement on the first health payload shape and which probes are safe to run synchronously vs cached.

principles: Installed is not the same as healthy
Health checks should explain next actions, not just color badges
Prefer cached probes to slow page loads
Surface app onboarding readiness separately from process liveness
Normalize app health without blocking on full suite convergence

techStack.runtime: systemctl, curl/fetch HTTP probes, SQLite health snapshots
techStack.storage: SQLite health snapshot table or cached in-process probe results for first pass
techStack.testing: Unit tests for status mapping + manual VM service failure/restore checks

userStories.title: Installed app cards show live service and HTTP state
acceptanceCriteria: Cards show deployment status and runtime health separately
Homebase probes systemd service state for installed apps
Homebase probes app readiness/liveness URL from catalog metadata
Failures show concise recovery guidance and link to app detail
userStories.testStrategy: Mocked probe tests plus manual VM stop/start service validation

userStories.title: Dashboard summarizes warnings and unhealthy apps
acceptanceCriteria: Dashboard lists app health warnings before recent jobs when action is needed
Health probes are cached or asynchronous so dashboard render stays fast
Critical host checks and app checks are visually distinct
userStories.testStrategy: UI tests/source assertions plus manual browser verification with one stopped app

userStories.title: Onboarding/readiness state is not conflated with install state
acceptanceCriteria: Apps with onboarding contracts can show needs setup vs ready
Open action remains available but recommended next action can be Setup when appropriate
Catalog metadata defines the bootstrap/readiness endpoint used where available
userStories.testStrategy: Catalog fixture tests and manual validation against Family Help/Family Plan onboarding endpoints

high: Synchronous host probes can make page loads slow or flaky
medium: Suite apps have inconsistent health/readiness endpoints
Systemd service names and app route health can diverge after manual repairs
low: Initial version can be read-only visibility with no destructive actions

preFlightChecklist: Define health status vocabulary: installed, service_running, healthy, needs_onboarding, unhealthy, unknown
Decide whether health snapshots get a SQLite table in this feature or a follow-up
List which catalog apps already have useful health/readiness endpoints
